title: Instant Pot Late-Night Cook Trend
app: Meater probes, Anova Precision Cooker sessions, Instant Pot logs, wine-fridge sensors, ESPHome kitchen sensors, and pantry inventory feeds via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=instantpot:cook
| eval hour=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H"))
| where hour>=22 OR hour<5
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as late_cooks by recipe _time
| sort - late_cooks
description: Uses Instant Pot session history telemetry to monitor which recipes keep being started very late at night in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for meal patterns that are pushing cleanup too late, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Instant Pot session history data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Monthly recipe leaderboard of late-night cooks.
grandmaExplanation: It blends which recipes keep being started very late at night so you can spot meal patterns that are pushing cleanup too late before it becomes annoying.
